# laravelforge_site_domain (Data Source)

Fetches a single domain record on a Laravel Forge site by ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the domain record.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server hosting the site.
- `site_id` (Number) ID of the site the domain belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `allow_wildcard_subdomains` (Boolean) Whether the domain allows wildcard subdomains.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `name` (String) The name of the domain.
- `status` (String) The status of the domain.
- `type` (String) The type of domain (`primary` or `alias`).
- `updated_at` (String) Last-updated timestamp.
- `www_redirect_type` (String) Type of `www` redirection (`from-www`, `to-www`, or `none`).
